summary: D-6 cupola cabin on St. Patrick Peak, Mineral County, Montana: log cabin 1919, cupola cabin 1923, newspaper staffing 1915-1940, destroyed 1965, site gone.

facts.design: D-6 cupola cabin built 1923 on a site developed with a log cabin in 1919
facts.status_note: destroyed in 1965 per firelookout.com; FFLA lists it as a ground-type lookout that is gone

staffing.status: lookout stationed in summers reported by newspapers in 1915, 1936 and 1940

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives a 1919 log cabin and a 1923 D-6 cupola cabin. A July 1915 newspaper item already names a station at the peak, and a February 1924 item says a lookout post was built the previous summer. The story gives the 1919 and 1923 dates and notes the 1915 item.

sources.title: St. Patrick Peak Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Newspaper items were read through the extracts on montanalookouts.weebly.com, not the original newspaper pages. The 1915 station predates the 1919 cabin on firelookout.com; the story reports the mismatch. No staffing after 1940 and no current site report were found. Access and visit rules are unknown. The brief's gone and ground record holds up.
